pages.title: Haunting
pages.text:
**Haunting** is fan processing through soul fire or a soul campfire (or a Lit Blaze Burner). It transforms the items it hits.\
\
Create Garnished adds many haunting recipes, and an orange turns into a Blood Orange this way. JEI lists them.
